g.text: Work sampling estimates an activity fraction; a unit learning curve models repetition time

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Independent random work-sampling snapshots, binary classification, and a normal interval are assumed; correlated or biased observations invalidate this
simple interval. The separate assigned80% unit-time learning curve reduces time to80% at each doubling. It is not the cumulative-average model, and does
not prove a person will follow that curve. No link between the two example datasets is implied.
